$comment: Mandatory rest zone doctrine. Structured version of v5/REST_ZONES.md.
definition: a region of the page where nothing moves - no scroll effect, no parallax, no hover response, no entrance animation, no drifting object
breaks_rest: drift, float, rotate, or breathe animation
hover transform on an element (color change alone is fine)
always-on shader or WebGL animation in viewport range
does_not_break_rest: hover feedback on genuinely interactive elements
cursor tracking that is invisible or off-screen
motion in the offscreen page area
placement_prompts: after a high-motion scene - give the reader ground
around dense content - long paragraphs, tables, data blocks
before a peak moment - silence before emphasis
avoid_placement_at: the very start of the page
the very end of the page
rest_zone_shapes: long editorial paragraph in calm column with generous margins
single large image with caption, no crop reveal
mostly whitespace with one headline anchored in it
dense feature list where each item is legible without scroll effect
quote at editorial scale on a clean surface
does_not_qualify: static section with hover-lift on cards
static section with slow background gradient shift
section static above the fold but scrolling into parallax as it exits
gate_blockers: zero rest zones on a page longer than 2 viewports
less than 20% rest coverage on a page longer than 3 viewports
rest zone interrupted by always-on background animation
